Read every worksheet in a local Excel workbook

Source: R/helper_functions.R
read_excel_allsheets.Rd

This internal helper reads each worksheet with readxl::read_excel() and names the resulting list with the workbook's sheet names. It does not make a network request. The package's public readers additionally normalise the returned worksheets into long-form observations.

Usage

read_excel_allsheets(filename, tibble = FALSE)

Arguments

filename

Path to a local .xls or .xlsx workbook.

tibble

If FALSE (the default), coerce each worksheet to a base data frame. If TRUE, retain the tibble returned by readxl::read_excel().

Value

A named list with one data-frame or tibble element per worksheet.
